'''Qorvin's Light Battalion''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit that was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A former member of the unit lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]], and considered the [[InterStellar Regulators]] to be no more than criminals.
